gpt-5-mini.exact_reserve_text: In January 2018 the Syndicate entered into a reinsurance-to-close ("RITC") with Enstar's Starstone Syndicate 2008 in respect of all earned 2015 and prior business. The financial impact of this transaction is reflected in the Statement of Profit and Loss at 31 December 2017. The assets and liabilities were transferred to Syndicate 2008 with effect from 1 January 2018, and are therefore included in the Statement of Financial Position 2017 comparative number. The impact on technical provisions is highlighted in note 4.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2018 the Syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,561.969m. During the year the Syndicate's gross reserves fell to GBP 965.311m at year-end primarily due to a large Reinsurance-to-Close transfer (effect of RITC) which removed earned 2015 and prior business from the syndicate (gross reduction ~ GBP 819.917m). Offsetting this release, there was a gross increase in the provision during the year (movement in provision GBP 179.578m) driven by a high frequency of catastrophe events in 2018 (notably Hurricanes Michael and Florence and California wildfires) and a rise in large individual losses. Because of the structural RITC transfer and in-year strengthening, reserve movements are mixed (large structural release plus in-year adverse development).

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening and closing gross claims outstanding are taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (page 20). A large Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) transfer of earned 2015 and prior business (gross (819,917)k) materially distorts year-on-year reserve movements and the claims development picture. The specific authoritative 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was not separately labelled in the notes (the reconciliation shows total 'Movement in provision' which combines current and prior year movements and an explicit 'Effect of RITC' line). Therefore a clean, RITC-adjusted prior year development aggregate (gross) could not be reliably determined from the disclosed notes - prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. Where present, numbers have been extracted from printed tables and converted from GBP'000 to millions.
